title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. dream interpretation 2701 views Q. I have few srilankan friends, met them in tabliq marqaz. I saw in my dream [close to Fajar waqth] two of my srilankan friends came in my dream gave three Moons to me. [i.e, 3 white color circle items with excellent bright in a plate]. Can you please interpret this dream. May Allah accept us in his loved once. Massalam 1451 views Q. I had a dream of a large python chasing me rapidly and I was running fast here and there after some time I went to a big stage and the snake got me and bit me 1821 views Q. Assalamu Alaikum? My question is i saw kaba very near and am hearing azan from inside kaabain my dream my elder sister also with me, please tell me the tabir of this dream???? 1458 views Q. By the Mercy and Grace of Allah, i offer five times salat daily with jammat, i have a beared, wear topi, enjoin tableeghi jamaats and try to follow as much sunnahs as i can, but never have i ever been blessed with the sight of rasulallah in a dream. I sometimes hear about some people who have just started practicing the deen and that too for a few weeks or so and in couple of weeks he is blessed with such a blissful sight, and to me many years have passed and i havent had such a dream. I do not mean that its my right to see the prophit of Allah in my dream or that i deserve it, on the contrary i feel i am quite a sinful person, but i want to ask 1) is there something that i am missing in my ibadaats or ikhlaas? do i have to do dua or wazeefa for it? 2)Does seing the prophit in the dream means that a person will be righteous through out his life? because i have seen people who have had the privelege of a such dream but they now rarely offer salat. 3) is it so that every pious person sees the prophit peace be upon him in dream? Does every alim, mufti, sheikh sees him in his or her dream? 1469 views Q. Person seemingly having reverted to Islam in dream 5784 views Q. استخارہ 1244 views Q. I am in a dilemma.Please guide me. 1508 views Q. Last year i saw a dream in the time of morning( that day i was a little late for my fajr prayer. I saw that my family members are mourning. I ask what has happened. My sister says that "be quite. Masood is dead(i am masood myself).i am very worried that how is it possible because i am alive .i see a person lying on the ground on white kafan and people are gathered around my dead body. I rise one corner of kafan to see who is inside. i see myself. my body is in a very bad condition. My skin peels( sheds) like the plastic paints on the wall when it get moist. i become very afraid and wake up. since then i am very upset about my future. I pray five times a say and alhamdulillah trying act on all quran and sunnah teachings. I asked many ulama. some said it is a good dream to see yourself dead. But i am very upset about my condition of dead body. PLEASE tell me the ta'beer of this dream I will pray for you and your whole team that may Allah bless you all and enable you to serve the whole humanity and like other deoband ulama, keep the light of Islam shining on these dark days of ignorance. thank you 3839 views Q. Dream 1338 views Q. Refund of money 1780 views Q. dream of tawaf 4475 views Q. I am an employee of autonomous body and very busy with my job. I am living in developing new residential area since last 10 years. As per requirement the construction of a new masjid became necessary in our locality. For which a committe was formed and I become an office bearer of the masjid committee. I involve myself only for the cause of that all the constuction work of the masjid should be done as per the shari'a i.e. avoiding haram funds and materials. As I am very busy with my job and I offer daily five salat anywhere or in the house if the jama'at times over. Since I am not punctual to attend that local masjid to offer all five salat, hence some musalliyan are blaming me for the "khokli seerat" and say that "ta'ajjub hai aap ghar per namaz pade aur masjid doosron ke liye banaye". On continuous blaming by the musalliyan, now I want to leave membership from the masjid committee. Whereas 40% work of the constuction is remain to complete. And no other member look after the work carefully and maintain the shara'i oosool. May I leave this as majority of muslliyan dislike me? Please guide me what should I do? 2107 views Q. I went to bed reading Uswai-Rasul-Akram in the end the letter from Moulana Zakariya Khadlawi (PBUH) which regards to Dr.Abdul Hai (RA). Thereafter I slept and saw: I saw myself in a madarasa with many students with white clothing and I was sitting among them also. Thereafter I saw some moulana sahib with a bright beautiful smiling face and he gave me something to eat, we were sitting underneath a table. Thereafter I saw someone scolding a young kid (somewhere like 19 year old) who was sitting outside and was facing tough time. Then dream was over. Please I ask my scholars to interpret this dream and recommend me steps to take in my life, I am currently in a very bad shape in terms of spirituality, please mention me in your duass I feel very very lost. 1339 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 31473 Country: India Title: I recently got engaged, and after my engagement saw a dream in the early morning time that my engagement is broken. Question: I recently got engaged, and after my engagement saw a dream in the early morning time that my engagement is broken. I dont remember anything else in the dream. This has made me anxious. please respond to my querey at the soonest. Jazak Allah Answer ID: 31473 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 608/511/B=1432) This is a satanic whispering. Do not pay any attention to it. This relation of yours will be strong and durable. You should perform nikah trusting Allah and should not fall prey to a doubt. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
